ECT Is a Controversial Treatment of Last Resort. I Wish I’d Gotten It Sooner

Electroconvulsive therapy, or ECT, isn’t terribly fashionable. People sometimes get an uneasy look on their faces at the mention of it. The treatment has come a long way since those agonizing scenes in Miloš Forman’s One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest —but I understand why ECT still freaks people out.
